title: Market Position of Home-Site Lease Renewal Offers by Lot Class
content:
The twelve-month renewal offer on a Home-Site Lease is set by its market position: the raised rent — the twelve-month-equivalent rent plus the dollar increase of the renewal — is compared with the lot class's base monthly site rent for new residents and with the full calendar months of tenancy since the move-in date, read on the day the offer is issued.

| Raised rent compared with the base rent | Full months of tenancy | Twelve-month offer |
|---|---|---|
| above the base rent | 120 or more | the lesser of the two: the base rent |
| above the base rent | at least 60 but fewer than 120 | the midpoint of the raised rent and the base rent, rounded half up to the cent |
| above the base rent | fewer than 60 | the raised rent |
| equal to or below the base rent | any | the raised rent |

**Base monthly site rent for new residents, by lot class**

| Lot class | Base monthly site rent (USD) |
|---|---|
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | 587.00 |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | 621.00 |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | 668.00 |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | 709.00 |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | 752.00 |
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | 839.00 |

The midpoint is the raised rent plus the base rent, divided by two.

**Hypothetical cases on a Lakefront Multi-Section site (base rent 839.00)**

| Raised rent | Tenure | Offer | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| 880.40 | 130 months | 839.00 | above the base rent, 120 months or more |
| 880.40 | 120 months | 839.00 | the 120-month threshold is met on reaching it |
| 880.40 | 119 months | 859.70 | midpoint of 880.40 and 839.00 |
| 880.45 | 75 months | 859.73 | midpoint 859.725, rounded half up |
| 880.40 | 60 months | 859.70 | the 60-month threshold is met on reaching it |
| 880.40 | 59 months | 880.40 | fewer than 60 months |
| 830.00 | 150 months | 830.00 | not above the base rent |
